mentions.name: Secure Configurable Authentication System
mentions.description: This is a secure, configurable, and easy-to-use authentication system built to address knowledge gaps and blind spots in authentication practices, such as TOTP using symmetric encryption with providers often storing the secret key in plaintext.
mentions.problem: Users worry about hashed password security while overlooking that TOTP (e.g., Google Authenticator) uses symmetric encryption and many authentication providers store the private key in plaintext in their database; the builder aims to fix these blind spots.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to build a secure, configurable and easy to use authentication system (relative to my understanding)
